source: https://www.e-arrivalcard.go.kr/portal/main/index.do and the application entry page https://www.e-arrivalcard.go.kr/portal/apply/agreementPolicy.do (email box and the portal's shared input checks for passport number, passport name and dates, read 2026-10-15; the form behind the email step was not opened)

passport.label: Passport number
passport.help: Use the passport number from the photo page.

full_name.label: Full name
full_name.help: Use the Latin spelling from your passport. The K-EAC passport-name boxes keep English letters and spaces only and turn them into capitals.

errors.invalidChars: English letters and spaces only — the form drops hyphens and other marks

date_of_birth.label: Date of birth
date_of_birth.help: YYYY-MM-DD — the K-EAC date boxes take digits and format them the same way.

errors.tooLate: Date of birth cannot be later than today

arrival_date.label: Arrival date
arrival_date.help: YYYY-MM-DD, the date you arrive in Korea.

email.label: Email
email.help: Confirmation is sent here. The K-EAC email box keeps only letters, digits and _ - . @ — a + is dropped without warning, so use an address without one. Up to 100 characters, typed twice.

errors.invalidFormat: The email format is incorrect. Please check again. (No +)
